question: Across the frozen 125-case ICASSP2022 pure-far corpus, is public-DTD occupancy more strongly associated with source mic absolute level/shape or with source lpb absolute level/shape, using only threshold-free source PCM statistics plus exact PCM16 saturation occupancy?

selection.rule: reuse the exact frozen all-complete-pair ICASSP2022 no-movement farend-singletalk inventory

observation_method.source_peak_abs: max(abs(PCM16))/32768 over full common-length source clip
observation_method.exact_saturation_fraction: fraction of PCM16 samples with abs(sample) >= 32767; this is exact integer saturation occupancy, not a tuned near-clipping threshold
observation_method.public_dtd: reuse freshly regenerated predecessor provenance evidence on the exact same inventory and source revision

outputs: per-case source mic/lpb energy ratio cross-check
cross-case Spearman associations with public-DTD occupancy
prohibited_actions: define or tune a near-clipping threshold
infer device AGC, microphone gain, loudspeaker gain, echo-path gain, noise, or nonlinear distortion as a proven physical cause
derive gain normalization or DTD thresholds
change any production source, DSP, API, version, release, or shipping policy
subsample or hand-pick cases after observing results
promote to source candidate, HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping
interpretation_rule: The diagnostic may describe whether public-DTD occupancy covaries more with source mic-side or lpb-side recording-level statistics. It cannot identify the physical cause of those source levels and cannot authorize normalization, thresholds, or a source candidate.
